phases.label: Diagnostics and plan
phases.reason:
We will inspect the current machine before changing files.

Required decision:
  Set your artifacts storage location.
  REASON: 𝚅𝚒𝚋𝚎𝚌𝚛𝚊𝚏𝚝𝚎𝚍. keeps the persistent artifacts on developer's hard disks
  for past session context retrieval. We make this location explicit so reports,
  transcripts, and run state can be inspected, moved, backed up, or deleted.
  Default: ${VIBECRAFTED_HOME:-$HOME/.vibecrafted}/artifacts

Installer options live in one place:
  runtime horse · skill views · Python tools · dry-run or automation mode

phases.label: Installation
phases.reason:
We will install the verified Runtime Pack through the public installer:

  - one immutable runtime generation with vc-terminal, vc-frame and vc-start
  - physical product configuration under ~/.config/vibecrafted
  - preserved preferences and receipted recovery snapshots
  - public launchers and shared agent views

The App and CLI use the same Runtime Pack installer. Installation errors stop
this phase; configuration is published only after conflict checks complete.

phases.label: Onboarding
phases.reason:
Health check, then the product question:

  Launch Vibecrafted now? [Y/n]

On Y we open the operator session (vc-start) with the Launchpad tab —
the map of the workspace (rail, chrome, keys). That is onboarding content
already in the frame layout; the installer only wires the door.

Restore honesty: layout/session resurrection is frame-level. Full agent
process freeze is NOT claimed here (docs/installer/RESTORE_CONTRACT.md).
